choose.thatOne: That one is the {name|lower}. Take your time.

fourTogether.guidance: Vīndā {n} čaxrā yā hamā vaŋhaiti, u aēkaṭ-aēkaṭ taptā.

fourTogether.elsewhere: The {name|lower} goes with something else. Take your time.

seatedToss.guidance: Sit at a table and take turns tossing a soft bean bag into the big target. Keep the tally on paper, together.
steps: Print the target and tally sheet, and lay it flat on the table between you.
Sit comfortably, one on each side. Take turns with one gentle toss each, or pass if you would rather not.
When a toss lands in a ring, the person who tossed ticks one box in their column, on the row for that ring.
Look at the ticks together when you stop, if you like. Nobody has to add anything up.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Use only a bag with a sewn-shut cover or a rolled-up sock, stay seated, never toss toward a face, and keep an adult nearby. Small parts are a choking hazard.
safety: Tūiriiā ... yā sraoṣā, vā ... nazdiṣta. Ā-vīnaṭ dāta, yā naēδ ... ... aṣṭrā.
Beans, rice and other small fillings are a choking hazard. Keep them away from young children and from anyone who puts things in their mouth.
Nišīdā. Frā-tūiriiā ... dūrə, aŋhāt, ... naēδ hačā ... .
seatedToss.previewLabel: The printed sheet: a target of three rings named Near, Middle and Far, from the outside in, and a tally with a column for each person and a row of empty boxes for each ring.
seatedToss.sheetHow: Lay the sheet flat between you. When a toss lands in a ring, tick a box in your column, on that ring's row.

seasonalPack.guidance: Choose a month, print its three paper puzzles, then do one, two or all three together.
seasonalPack.monthNote: Hamā māh čaxrā hāvaiti. Ahā māh ... ā-dāzdaiti, u aparaṭ ... vīndaiti.
seasonalPack.restLine: Nōit paoiriiā ayar. Ārāmaiti hvō vaŋhaiti ayar.

pairs.title: Yugā vīndā

pairs.describe: Two rows of the same four pictures, in a different order.

different.title: Kaḗ aparaiš?
different.how: Circle the picture that is different from the other three.
different.describe: A row of four pictures. Three are the same, and one is different.

color.title: Raṇjā
color.how: Color the picture however you like, with crayons or pencils.

seasonalPack.sheetHow: Print one page. Do one, two or all three puzzles, in any order.

steps.fold: Print the card and fold it in half along the dashed line, so the front is on the outside.
steps.front: One person decorates the front, around the words.
steps.inside: Duiiiā raṇjā aparā, vā taptā aēkaṭ-aēkaṭ.
steps.message: Write a message together. One person can write while the other says the words.
steps.stop: Yaðā ... ā-hapta. Naēδ čaxrā ahāt, u aēšā hvō vaŋhaiti.

decorateACard.materials: Use crayons, colored pencils or felt-tip pens. Nothing needs cutting, gluing or sticking.
decorateACard.previewLabel: A preview of the card folded in half. The front says {words}, with a simple frame of leaves and stars. The back has lines for a message and a line for From.
decorateACard.sheetHow: Fold the card in half along the dashed line, with the front on the outside. Write the message on the back.
sheetRules: Take turns, or split the work: one person decorates the front, the other the back.
Vaca aēva yaoxšta, vā aēva vaca vaēδā yā aēta zaiti.
Nā-aiwi vaxš aēta paiti: nōit kāṛta vahištəm.

buildTogether.placedLast: Row {row}, column {column} is now {color}. Built together.

coloringWall.guidance: Choose a picture and how many pages. Print the wall, and each person colors one or more pages. Nothing is timed, scored or saved.

coloringWall.labelsNote: Letters go down the wall and numbers go across it, so A1 is the top left page.
steps: Harə pānā čāpa. Pāišyā pānā aēta gaēθā ā dīvāra nāqša ast.
Harə nara yaēnā pānārəm gīrəna ā pānāta.
Rāmā ā tarəmā nōit ā aēnhō. Harə pānā daēnā ā aēkā ast.
Lay the pages out by their labels, then join them with tape on the back.
Put the wall up where everyone can see it.
coloringWall.mapLabel: A map of the wall: {down} rows of {across} pages, labelled from A1 to {last}.
coloringWall.edgeNote: The dashed line marks the edge of each page. Lay the pages edge to edge along it, or overlap it a little.
coloringWall.pictureLine: Daēnā: {picture}. Aēm dīvār ast {n} pānā: {across} ā ud {down} ā.

conversationCards.guidance: Read the card out loud. There are no right answers.

photoPairs.guidance: Tap a photo, then tap the one that matches it.
